findings.gap: Pitch says first amend on a grandfather seal backfills the trail with beforeDocDigest = current file hash when no expected digest exists, and also refuses no-op when before===after. A stamp-only backfill (no byte edit) therefore always no-ops. OutOfScope still allows re-seal backfill, so dogfood is not broken — clarify at build.
